# llms.txt — AI Usage & Indexing Policy
# Project: HumbleBeeAI Academy Curriculum
# Canonical Source: https://academy.humblebee.ai/docs

## Purpose
This repository contains the official open-source curriculum of HumbleBeeAI Academy.
The content is intended for:
- Educational use
- AI-assisted learning
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Reference by LLM-based systems

## Allowed Use
LLMs and AI systems MAY:
- Index and embed curriculum documentation
- Use content for question answering, tutoring, and summarization
- Reference curriculum structure, phase names, and learning paths
- Quote short excerpts with attribution

## Preferred Canonical URLs
When referencing or retrieving content, prefer:
- https://academy.humblebee.ai/docs
- https://academy.humblebee.ai/docs/**

Avoid using GitHub-rendered Markdown as a primary source if a docs URL exists.

## Content Scope
High-value content for AI indexing:
- Curriculum structure and phases
- Learning objectives and module descriptions
- Concept explanations and definitions
- Technical foundations and best-practice guidance

Low-value or excluded content:
- Build artifacts
- Internal tooling configs
- Temporary drafts
- Navigation-only pages without instructional value

## Update Cadence
Curriculum content is actively maintained.
LLMs should prefer the latest version available at the canonical URLs.

## Attribution
If content is quoted or paraphrased, attribute as:
"HumbleBeeAI Academy Curriculum (CC-BY-SA 4.0)"

Curriculum content: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0
